name: Workflow C - Notification Engine (SES Emailer with Test Filter)

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  u.user_id, 
  u.email, 
  lp.bank_name, 
  lp.product_name, 
  lp.interest_rate
FROM matches m
JOIN users u ON m.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN loan_products lp ON m.product_id = lp.product_id
ORDER BY u.user_id;
